market_demand_anchors.evidence: Koh Samui Airport (USM) currently handles around 2 million passengers annually; Bangkok Airways investing $69M to expand.
Passenger arrivals increased 21% in 2024 and 9% YoY in early 2025, surpassing pre-pandemic levels.
Bangkok Airways reported >1.4 million passengers using Samui airport Jan-Jun, +22% YoY.

market_demand_anchors.source: Wikipedia / Thai Dept of Civil Aviation (historical)
market_demand_anchors.evidence: Historical clean-year totals: 2019 = 1,208,882 total pax (14,325 flights); 2015 arrivals = 1,024,373. Bangkok Airways near-monopoly base.

corridors.premium_ceiling_note: Resort/private speedboat charters Samui<->Phangan list THB 3,500-8,000 per boat (premium transfer ceiling Navier targets). Published scheduled floor THB 200-500/seat.

demand_anchors.evidence: Full Moon Party at Haad Rin (Koh Phangan) draws ~20,000 revellers per event; ~98% foreigners.
Regular months 5,000-20,000 visitors; peak season up to 30,000 per party.
~50,000 tourists attended one high-season Full Moon Party; local speedboat operators surged capacity.

inputs.samui_routing_share_basis: Samui (USM, ~2M pax/yr, Bangkok Airways hub) is the dominant air gateway feeding Phangan; ~55% of FMP arrivals route via Samui ferry vs Surat Thani mainland / direct Phangan. LABELLED ASSUMPTION pending operator manifest.
inputs.premium_share_basis: Share willing to pay a premium foiling transfer over the THB 200-500 ferry floor (resort guests, time-sensitive, FMP surge). Labelled assumption.

derived_demand_record.calc: 12 * 20000 * 0.98 * 0.55 = ~129,360 FMP-driven Samui<->Phangan pax/yr (one-way). Add ~year-round baseline ferry traffic (separate). Premium-eligible slice = 129,360 * 0.15 = ~19,400 premium one-way trips/yr from the FMP pool alone.
derived_demand_record.fare_basis: Lomprayah scheduled high-speed seat THB 350 = ~$10 as the contested floor; premium charter ceiling far higher (see premium_ceiling_note).

demand_anchors.evidence: High-speed ferries to Ko Tao and Chumphon depart Maenam Beach Pier; Samui is the air gateway feeding the Tao dive-tourism corridor.

inputs.note: Koh Tao receives an estimated ~400-500k visitors/yr (dive tourism); Samui-routed share is a labelled assumption pending operator data.
